components.name: textcli-count
components.responsibility: Parse the 'count' command, read the UTF-8 file, compute lines/words/chars, print the result or the not-found error with the right exit code

data_flows.data: command line arguments (count <path>) and file bytes
stdout 'lines words chars', stderr error message, exit code

nfr_mapping.approach: argparse, pathlib and built-in str methods only; one module

tradeoffs.rationale: the user asked for a single simple component; an internal split would add an interface for no benefit

integration_test_strategy.approach: Single component without internal interfaces; its only boundary is the external CLI, which is verified by G7 system tests. Integration verification is not applicable.
